messages:
Lucas: Heads-up 1: ACME Dedicated bring-up is tomorrow 2026-03-27 09:00 UTC. Need final quota numbers, autoscale rules, load scripts + failback runbook.
Nia: From product: steady 900 QPS, burst 2.5k for 4m. We should do a 5% canary then ramp.
Zoe: Renewal flag 1: customer wants SLA conversation in same-week QBR if p95 >120ms. Marking as yellow.
Rafael: Pool note: reserved 6xH100-80GB by default. We can temp-add 2 GPUs for initial 48h. Recommend pinning models to nodes to avoid noisy neighbors.
Lucas: Draft autoscale (please comment):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min: 3
  max: 10
  policies:
    - signal: p95_latency_ms
      target: 110
      window: 60s
    - signal: request_queue_size
      target: 100
      window: 30s
```
Nia: Change request: use p95 window 90s for stability, add a cooldown 120s. Also ensure scale-in grace 300s.
ProbeBot: Shadow probe scheduled 2026-03-27T09:00Z->10:00Z script=acme-shadow-v2.json ramp=10m hold=40m decay=10m. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-acme/shadow/1768471110/
Zoe: Can we include two customer flows - short lookup and multi-turn summarization? Need token distribution in results.
Rafael: I'll deploy KV priming and node pinning to staging. ETA Wed 22:00 UTC.
Lucas: Failback runbook (sketch):
1) Pause canary traffic
2) Shift 100% to fallback model (quantized variant)
3) Increase replicas to max_temp (if available)
4) Open incident & notify CSMs
Nia: Add rollback command snippets: `repoint-traffic --to=fallback --wait 30s` and `set-autoscale --max=20 --reason=emergency`
Zoe: I'll coordinate enablement (30m) with ACME engineers, request two sample prompts and expected latency targets.
Lucas: Action items:
- @Nia: finalize autoscale windows + add cooldown by EOD
- @Rafael: confirm + provision extra GPUs for first 48h
- @Zoe: collect sample prompts and schedule 30m enablement session
- @ProbeBot: run shadow and upload logs
Zoe: Account health = yellow -> noting renewal risk in QBR doc and ops playbook.
Nia: Posting dry-run dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/acme/dryrun/1768471110
Lucas: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after probe results and decide whether to keep the GPU cushion for 72h. :white_check_mark:
